claim: Try it with sample data loads four example drills and a practice log without changing saved data.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; seed a real drill separately, edit/reset demo data, then start for real and compare both IndexedDB namespaces.

claim: Tempo Lab is free to use.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; open the supplied drills and confirm no account or payment control is required.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service-worker control, set offline, reload, and inspect the sample drill.

claim: A drift drill repeats its two-bar tempo pattern inside the selected BPM limit.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; open the planned-tempo output, reload, and compare sample values and limits.

claim: A tempo ramp moves evenly between supported BPM endpoints.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; load the sample ramp and inspect its planned-tempo output.

claim: A delayed-beat drill delays its selected cue while later beats remain on the tempo grid.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; run the sample delay drill at a short, fast setting and record its visible cue phases.

claim: A recovery drill gives reference bars, the selected silent bars, and a recovery bar.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; run the sample recovery drill and observe all visible phases.

claim: Tempo Lab provides sound, visual, and supported-device vibration cues.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; observe audio and visual cues, mock supported vibration, and inspect the unsupported-device label.

claim: Saving a named drill keeps it in this browser after reload.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; save a named sample drill and reload.

claim: A share link contains drill settings and no practice log.
where: Copy share link control and privacy policy
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; copy a link, inspect its query fields, and open it in a new browser context.

claim: Stopped and completed drills are added to the practice log.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; start and stop the supplied drill, then inspect the visible log and demo database.

claim: Exports the practice log as CSV.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; download the supplied log and verify its header and one row per sample attempt.

claim: Backs up and imports drills and practice attempts as JSON.
where: Back up JSON and Import JSON controls and README
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; download the supplied backup, parse it, and import it through the product control.

claim: Drills and logs stay in this browser.
where: Landing facts, privacy policy, and README
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; save a drill and inspect both IndexedDB namespaces.

claim: Clearing browser site data removes saved drills and practice attempts.
sandbox: Fresh browser starts at /demo, saves a real drill, clears IndexedDB with the browser’s site-data control, and reloads the real workspace.

claim: Tempo Lab has no third-party runtime request during normal demo use.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; capture every request while starting and stopping the supplied drill, then allow only the product origin.

claim: Tempo Lab gives timing cues without recording or grading a musician.
where: What Tempo Lab does not do and README
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo with a recording microphone stub; start and stop a drill and assert no microphone call occurs.

claim: Press Space to start or stop outside a form field.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; use Space on the document and then inside the drill-name field.

claim: Tempo Lab has a standalone app manifest.
sandbox: Fresh browser at /demo; load the linked manifest and confirm its standalone display, icons, and controlled service worker.

claim: The production build writes a deployable app to dist with index.html at its root.
sandbox: The Playwright production server builds the app, opens /demo, and checks the generated dist/index.html artifact.
